node.label: T. C. Smout
node.description: A historian of Scottish society who helped establish environmental history in Scotland. A History of the Scottish People, 1560–1830 (1969) and A Century of the Scottish People (1986) are his social histories of Scotland. His 1990 British Academy lecture ‘The Highlands and the Roots of Green Consciousness’ questions the story that appreciation of Highland landscapes was simply imported into an indifferent society. In later environmental work he draws on E. A. Wrigley’s account of the shift from organic to fossil-fuel economies, and names William Cronon’s city-and-hinterland history as a model for studies of Scottish cities still to be written.
